table.retrieve:
select   
	glheader.glvochcode,
	gldetail.debit,
	gldetail.credit,
	date = glheader.date,
	type = 	RTRIM(LTRIM((SELECT V.SHORTNAME 
				FROM vochercategory v 
				WHERE v.vochcatcode = glheader.vochcatcode))) + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), glheader.glvochcode))),
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = glheader.acccode),
	accountgroup=(Select subaccounts.name from accounts, subaccounts where accounts.acccode = gldetail.acccode and accounts.subcode=subaccounts.subacccode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = gldetail.acccode),
	glheader.vouchercode,
	invoicecode=gldetail.invoicecode,
	posted = glheader.posted
from
	glheader,
	gldetail		 	
where
	glheader.glvochcode = gldetail.glvochcode and
	glheader.acccode <> gldetail.acccode and 
	glheader.vochcatcode IN (1, 3, 15, 16) and
	glheader.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
union all
select   
	glvochcode=PurLedger.PurInvCode,
	debit=PurLedger.amt,
	credit=0, 
	date = PurLedger.date,
	type = 'PV-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), PurLedger.PurInvCode))),  
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = PurLedger.PaymentAccCode),
	accountgroup=(Select subaccounts.name from accounts, subaccounts where accounts.acccode = PurLedger.SuppCode and accounts.subcode=subaccounts.subacccode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = PurLedger.SuppCode),
	vouchercode=PurLedger.HeaderInvNo,
	invoicecode=PurLedger.PurInvCode,
	posted = PurLedger.posted
from
	PurLedger
where    
	PurLedger.amt <> 0 AND
	PurLedger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
union all
select   
	glvochcode=SRLedger.SRInvCode,
	debit=SRLedger.amt,
	credit=0, 
	date = SRLedger.date,
	type = 'SR-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), SRLedger.SRInvCode))),  
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = SRLedger.PaymentAccCode),
	accountgroup=(Select subaccounts.name from accounts, subaccounts where accounts.acccode = SRLedger.CustCode and accounts.subcode=subaccounts.subacccode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = SRLedger.CustCode),
	vouchercode=SRLedger.HeaderInvNo,
	invoicecode=SRLedger.SRInvCode,
	posted = SRLedger.posted
from
	SRLedger
where    
	SRLedger.amt <> 0 AND
	SRLedger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
union all
select   
	glvochcode=Notes.NoteCode,
	debit=Notes.amount, 
	credit=0,
	date = Notes.duedate,
	type = 'NP-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), Notes.NoteCode))),  
	accounthead=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = Notes.AccCode),
	accountgroup=(Select subaccounts.name from accounts, subaccounts where accounts.acccode = Notes.BankAccCode and accounts.subcode=subaccounts.subacccode),
	accountname=(Select name from accounts where accounts.acccode = Notes.BankAccCode),
	vouchercode=Notes.vouchercode,
	invoicecode=NULL,
	posted = Notes.posted
from
	Notes
where    
	Notes.NoteCatCode=2 AND
	Notes.duedate BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_endDate
table.sort: accountgroup A, date A, type A, accounthead A, accountname A
